purpose: Define bounded offline change queues and reconnect replay semantics so disconnected operation cannot create unbounded, duplicated or authority-bypassing writes.

owns: DWH Offline Queue and Replay semantics

value.queue_rule: Offline change intent is stored as explicit queued operation/change identity.
value.target_rule: Queued entry retains exact source/destination/record/operation refs.
value.auth_rule: Reconnect replay reevaluates current authorization/assurance where required; old authorization context is not assumed eternally valid.
value.revision_rule: Replay validates expected source/destination revision before apply.
value.idempotency_rule: Successfully accepted queue entry is not applied again merely due to reconnect/retry.
value.conflict_rule: Stale/divergent queued writes enter explicit conflict/reconciliation rather than blind replay.
value.failure_rule: Expired/invalid/denied queue entries become explicit failed/review states.
value.ordering_rule: Replay ordering is explicit and does not imply authority.

invariants.rule: Replica/sync state, transport position or local copy never replaces the semantic identity or ownership of the authoritative source data; propagation is explicit, provenance-bearing and conflict-aware.

references.purpose: Replay interacts with exact sync position.
